caption: Onboarding stops here until you link a calendar: Continue stays grey and there is no skip or later option. You see nothing of the app before Reclaim can write to a calendar.
The public pricing page on monthly billing: Lite free, Starter $12 and Business $18 per seat a month. On yearly billing Starter is $10 and Business $15.
Our habit Test focus block was in the calendar within seconds, solid on Wednesday and provisional on Thursday and Friday. Our two test tasks in the panel on the right got no block of their own.
We added a busy appointment at 10am on Wednesday and the habit moved itself to 11am in about 3 seconds. Moving a task deadline a day earlier changed nothing in the calendar.
Inside the app on yearly billing in euros: Starter 8, Business 15 and Enterprise 22 euro per seat a month, with Lite marked Current. We selected no plan and paid nothing.

The primary calendar cannot be disconnected; deleting the account is the only way out. The sync buttons carry a Starter label, while both pricing pages promise Lite 1 Calendar Sync. Account details are hidden.
